Show Kawakami Princess (Summer Gym Clothes)
Fusaichi Pandora (Summer Gym Clothes) runs in

She wasn't going to suddenly gain boundless grit overnight.
Judging by her posture... she looked ready to give up.

Princess—Brute Force—Amaaazing!!
Daryaryaryaaa~!!

I wonder if I'll become like that
one day.

You are doing surprisingly well... However!
As a princess, I have a secret finishing move up my sleeve!

For real?! In that case—I can't afford to lose!!
Not if you're gonna do what you wouldn't do the other day!!

For a moment, Kawakami Princess's face stiffens.
Fusaichi Pandora is still a butterfly yet to emerge from her chrysalis. Even so—
No, I get it, but still...

From here on out, it's a battle of will! Normally, she would have crumbled here, but
the reborn Fusaichi Pandora is—

Waha, I'm totally pumped up now☆ I mean, no one else can hype me up
as well as you, Trainer, seriously♪

Fusaichi Pandora happily munches on her sandwich.
And then—
Fer real?! Guhhhhh...?!

What made the difference in victory wasn't just Fusaichi Pandora's improved skills,
but more than anything—

Wh... Wh...? ...Whaaaaat,
what is with that sprint~~~?!

So since I won, we're making a contract, right? A contract!
You promised☆

(Even before I started running... ever since I was tiny, I've had it all the time.
Could that dream be...)

Her raw talent is top tier. Now that I've managed to motivate her
and get her through the bare minimum training—

—A rematch against Kawakami Princess. I roll the video camera,
determined to capture every bit of Fusaichi Pandora's performance on tape.

Kawakami-senpai, thaaanks for having me☆
I came to pay you back♪

I cheer with all my might. But cheering alone isn't enough to fire her up.
In that case—

Thanks to that, I had an awesome run! With you, Trainer,
I'm already a genius, but I might run even more amazingly!

You certainly seem to be in high spirits.
Very well, allow me to utterly shatter that carefree mood of yours!

—?!
Matching... outfits!??
Oh, matching outfits! About that, though~...

You are more than welcome. As a princess,
I am quite accustomed to dealing with counterattacks, you know?

A peaceful lunch with my trainee, having finally signed an official contract.
Yet during our conversation, surprisingly...
Whoa, that's insane...! Just what I'd expect from Kawakami-senpai. But...!

Let's talk and decide together what kinda matching vibe to go with☆
I mean, we're total besties now, right?♪

The fact that I had learned "how to handle" her.
The technique of managing her motivation was what brought victory.

Still, I vowed to turn it into reality one day. Even if the path is long,
I will make her an incredible Umamusume.

Yeah! Well, less of a goal and more like,
a dream I sometimes see while fast asleep!
Is it some kinda destiny, maybe?

(If I can't do it after trying this hard... guess it's impossible~.
Bummer... but don't sweat it, me!)
RAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!
I've been working haaard too, you knooow~~~!!

A tent for Fusaichi Pandora to rest in. Frozen drinks with honey.
Handmade sandwiches for lunch, and more.

Nom nom nom...♪ Sho good☆
Like, I'm toshally a shuper genus, riiight~?!

Trainer, make sure you shoot me looking super cool and cute♡
Hey-ya, yaaay☆

The dream Fusaichi Pandora sees—a butterfly's dream.
A dream that feels real, reality that feels like a dream.
ALLLLRIIIIGHT☆
DORYAAAAAAAHHH!!

Trainer, you know what?
I actually have a dream.
And so, our duo was somehow formed—that very night.

Yay, yay, yaaay♪ Trainer, did you see, did you see?
Sandwich, pleeease☆
(Though, honestly... that dream is kinda weird...)

Win tons and tons of GⅠs! Then put on an
amazing show in front of everyone and appeeal with total cuteness♪
